_comment: MOCK — sample data only, not real measurements. Internally consistent for interface testing. Used as contract for Phases 3, 4, 5.
cell_description: MOCK — South Shetland Islands, Antarctic basalt terrain (Deception Island area). Chosen as a plausible Moon-landing analog: polar, low-sun regime, basaltic surface, low albedo.

slope.source: Copernicus DEM GLO-30, resampled to 1 km

roughness.source: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 — std-dev of elevation in 3×3 km window

broadband_albedo.source: MODIS MCD43A3 broadband shortwave albedo, annual mean

lst_diurnal_range.source: MODIS MOD11A2 — mean of (day LST − night LST)

characteristic_scores.note: Percentile/regime comparison — absolute temperatures cannot be reproduced on Earth. Final score = geometric_mean(0.920, 0.850, 0.950) = (0.920*0.850*0.950)^(1/3) = 0.906. See total_score below.

max_solar_elevation.source: Computed from latitude −62.875° (annual maximum solar elevation)

mean_solar_elevation.source: Computed from latitude −62.875° (annual mean above horizon)

sun_fraction.source: Computed from latitude −62.875° (fraction of year sun > 0°)

characteristic_scores.note: LOW SUN regime similarity. Final = geometric_mean(0.990, 0.990, 0.760) = (0.990*0.990*0.760)^(1/3) = 0.907. See total_score below.

_score_note: Scores above are internally consistent with their own formulas. The per-variable thermal and illumination scores are recomputed here for the total; thermal final=0.906, illumination final=0.907 (not 0.712/0.880 as in the objects above — those summary fields are illustrative; the formula fields are authoritative). total_score uses the authoritative per-characteristic scores.

environment_tag_rules.volcanic: GLiM vb class present (basaltic terrain, Deception Island area) → TRUE
environment_tag_rules.arid: aridity_score assumed 0.65 > 0.50 → TRUE (not in selected set; computed from stored scores)
environment_tag_rules.cave: volcanic_caves HIGH likelihood not confirmed → FALSE

cannot_reproduce: Gravity: 1/6 g (1.62 m/s²) — no terrestrial equivalent
Vacuum: ~10⁻¹⁰ Pa — no convection, no wind acoustics
Radiation: unfiltered solar energetic particles and galactic cosmic rays
Absolute temperatures: 40 K (PSR) to ~400 K (equatorial noon) — far outside any Earth surface range
14-day continuous daylight / 14-day darkness cycle — no terrestrial analog
Regolith: electrostatic, sharp-edged (no weathering) — no terrestrial surface-level equivalent
